principle.name: THE CATCH SPENDS VERTICAL DEBT WHILE FORWARD DEBT SURVIVES
principle.summary: A forward catch earns ownership in stages: probe, bite, deep fold, chest sling, overshoot, then support roll. The root never teleports to rest, and recovery debt remains visible at exit.
principle.minimal_maximal_unit: one repaired forward support-ownership handoff from asymmetric rear coil through launch/probe/bite/deep catch/overshoot to explicit foot-roll and unresolved recovery-debt exit
